title: Understanding the Problem
text: To find the minimum and maximum possible values of the threshold, consider the probabilities where the prediction changes from $$0$$ to $$1$$ or vice versa.

title: Analyzing Predictions
text: Look at the probabilities where the true label and prediction differ. These are the points where the threshold could be set to change the prediction.

title: Identifying Thresholds
text: The threshold must be between the highest probability of a false prediction and the lowest probability of a true prediction.

title: Calculating Minimum Threshold
text: What is the highest probability where the prediction is $$0$$ but the true label is 1?

title: Calculating Maximum Threshold
text: What is the lowest probability where the prediction is $$1$$ and the true label is 1?
